customize.name: Snowball Blooms Atop Snowfields
customize.desc: A classic layered salad. Each ingredient is prepared separately, then stacked in layers with seasoned sour cream dressing spread between them. Once assembled, the salad is usually left to rest for a while so the flavors can fully meld. The finished dish resembles clusters of snowball blooms blooming over a snowy field, which is how it earned its name.
